annotations.title: 30% ruling year by year (30%, 27% from 2027, the end after 5 years)

description: Net income year by year for an employee with the Dutch 30% ruling: 30%, then 27% from 2027 for rulings that started in 2024 or later, the salary norm, the end of the ruling after five years, and Box 3 on Dutch and foreign assets (partial non-resident status only for rulings that started before 2024).

dutch_assets.description: Savings and investments in the Netherlands, euros. Default 0.

fiscal_partner.description: Has a fiscal partner (double Box 3 allowance). Default false.

partial_non_resident.description: Chose partial non-resident status (only for rulings that started before 2024). Default false.

start_year.description: Year the ruling started (January assumed), 2019-2026. Default 2025.
